'''Richard Haman''' (also written '''Richard Harmon''') was a Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 86 in the Coruscant region, from Hawthorne, NJ.<ref name="decsq-coruscant" /><ref name="smlist" />

He played from just after the Hoth release and became a Squadron Member in November 1998, one of the first two in New Jersey. By 2000 he had been running tournaments for over two years. Outside the game he was a police officer.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
